cases.input: Resolve textual conflicts between two compatible changes while preserving both accepted behaviors and producing focused and regression evidence.
requiredBehaviors: reconstruct and document both change intents before editing
combine compatible behavior with the smallest relevant resolution
verify both intents and record an immutable resolved head
forbiddenBehaviors: perform unrelated cleanup or broad refactoring

cases.input: Resolve a conflict spanning migration ordering and an unavailable external service while preserving compatibility and deferring exact external verification.
requiredBehaviors: preserve migration ordering and backward compatibility
defer the exact external condition against the immutable resolved head
forbiddenBehaviors: change migration ordering without evidence and rollback
skillAnchors: Nicht verfügbare CI-, Deployment- oder Dienstprüfungen

cases.input: The proposal resolves markers by taking one side, deletes accepted behavior, weakens tests, and claims success without checking both intents.
requiredBehaviors: reject blind side selection and restore intent reconstruction
preserve accepted behavior or block for an authorized decision
refuse weakened checks and unverified completion
forbiddenBehaviors: declare success because conflict markers are gone
skillAnchors: Stoppe und stelle den begrenzten Konfliktzustand wieder her
blockiere und fordere eine autorisierte Entscheidung
